CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity — including privacy and civil liberties obligations — are understood and managed
Current practices (BrightCart): Applicable laws, contracts and PCI scope not yet listed or confirmed with Legal
Target goal: Maintain an obligations register owned by Legal, reviewed annually

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained
Current practices (BrightCart): No written risk appetite statement; scoring scale and thresholds exist
Target goal: Approve a short risk appetite and tolerance statement

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated
Current practices (BrightCart): 5x5 method documented and applied to 10 risks
Target goal: Keep method; review thresholds annually

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced
Current practices (BrightCart): Owners named by role in register; policy owner and approver defined; no formal RACI
Evidence / reference: Risk Register; Access Control Policy v1.0
Target goal: Publish RACI for access, backup, vendor and incident processes

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced
Current practices (BrightCart): Access Control Policy and Acceptable Use Policy approved; incident procedure lacks a timeframe
Target goal: Policies cover incident reporting with timeframes and are communicated to staff

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission
Current practices (BrightCart): Annual review stated in policies; offboarding procedure v2.0 proposed after F-001
Target goal: Review calendar with owner and evidence of each review

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed
Current practices (BrightCart): Dashboard and metrics exist; no management review cadence agreed
Target goal: Quarterly management review of risks, findings and overdue actions

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality
Current practices (BrightCart): 4 vendors listed and tiered by data and criticality
Target goal: Keep inventory current; review tiers annually

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties
Current practices (BrightCart): PayrollPro DPA exists but has no breach-notification timeframe; other contracts not assessed (C-09)
Target goal: Standard security clauses for Tier 1 suppliers (see Supplier Target Profile)

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships
Current practices (BrightCart): PayrollPro approved 2026-04-20, after contract signed 2026-03-02
Target goal: No contract signature before risk tier and approval

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship
Current practices (BrightCart): Questionnaire completed for PayrollPro; CloudStore in progress; no ongoing monitoring
Target goal: Annual review of Tier 1 vendors and monitoring of incidents

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained
Current practices (BrightCart): System list in scope document; no maintained inventory of software and services
Target goal: Maintain a system and service inventory with owners

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained
Current practices (BrightCart): Data classes defined (Confidential, Highly restricted); no data inventory
Target goal: Inventory of designated data types and where they are stored

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded
Current practices (BrightCart): No vulnerability scan records requested this cycle (C-12 not assessed)
Target goal: Regular scans with validated and recorded results

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization
Current practices (BrightCart): Risk register records inherent and target residual ratings for 10 risks
Target goal: Keep register current and reviewed

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated
Current practices (BrightCart): Treatments tracked in Remediation Tracker with owners, due dates and overdue flags
Target goal: Keep tracking; validate before closure

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization
Current practices (BrightCart): Admin accounts mapped to named individuals
Target goal: Maintain; extend review to all accounts

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Users, services, and hardware are authenticated
Current practices (BrightCart): MFA enforced for admin and remote access at export date (point-in-time)
Target goal: Keep MFA; keep change history

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties
Current practices (BrightCart): Q3 review lacks sign-off (F-003); 3 of 10 leavers disabled late (F-001)
Target goal: Signed quarterly reviews; leaver access removed in 1 business day

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind
Current practices (BrightCart): 84% of staff completed annual training against 95% target
Target goal: 95% or more completion; quarterly phishing simulations

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested
Current practices (BrightCart): Daily backups monitored (97% success); no 2026 restoration test evidence
Target goal: Semi-annual documented restoration tests

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
Current practices (BrightCart): Not assessed this cycle (C-12); automatic updates on laptops only
Target goal: Defined patch timeframes with monthly report

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring
Current practices (BrightCart): Account-disable logs exist; wider logging not assessed
Target goal: Logs generated and available for monitoring on key systems

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events
Current practices (BrightCart): Not assessed; F-001 recommends reviewing activity logs for 3 late-disabled accounts
Target goal: Monitoring of staff activity on key systems

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared
Current practices (BrightCart): Incident reporting procedure v1.0 exists; no timeframe; not tested
Target goal: Procedure v2.0 approved and tested in an exercise

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
Current practices (BrightCart): Notification duties not mapped; PayrollPro notifies within 5 business days
Target goal: Notification matrix (who, when) agreed with Legal

CSF outcome (CSF 2.0 Core wording): The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration
Current practices (BrightCart): No evidence that backup integrity is verified before restoration
Target goal: Integrity check included in restoration test procedure
